# Huiying Filter Data

> Canonical product database for the huiying filter manufacturer — structured SKU records,
> reference-level vehicle-fitment framework and filter-media comparison. Machine-readable,
> zero marketing. 10 SKUs across 5 categories; 13 vehicle models in the fitment reference
> framework. Operator: Qinghe County Huiying Filter Manufacturing Co., Ltd. — commercial
> catalog and inquiries at huiyingfilter.com.

- [Home](https://data.huiying.com/): data-site overview, section index and honest data posture.
- [SKU Index](https://data.huiying.com/products/): all 10 SKUs (identity verified; specs NEEDS_VERIFICATION).
- [Air Filter category](https://data.huiying.com/products/air-filter/): 8 SKUs.
- [Cabin Filter category](https://data.huiying.com/products/cabin-filter/): 1 SKU.
- [Oil Filter category](https://data.huiying.com/products/oil-filter/): 1 SKU.
- [Fuel Filter category](https://data.huiying.com/products/fuel-filter/): 0 SKUs (placeholder).
- [Wiper category](https://data.huiying.com/products/wiper/): 0 SKUs (placeholder).

## Notes

- Per-SKU dimensions, material, efficiency, OE numbers and packing are NOT published by the
  source catalogue; they are marked `NEEDS_VERIFICATION` here, never invented.
- Vehicle fitment is `reference` only — common applications, not verified OE cross-references.
- Filter-media efficiency figures are typical framework ranges (`[框架参考]`), not measured SKU specs.
- Commercial catalog and quotations: huiyingfilter.com (this data site is reference-only).
